newsitem.title: UK: Northern Electric urges no action on CE bid.
newsitem.headline: Northern Electric urges no action on CE bid.

text.p: British regional utility Northern Electric Plc on Tuesday reiterated its view that the hostile bid by CE Electric undervalued the company and urged shareholders to take no action.
CE is the UK unit of U.S.-based CalEnergy Co Inc.
"CalEnergy itself recognises the strategic and commercial advantages which Northern would bring to it. But it is trying to buy these benefits on the cheap," chairman David Morris said in a statement.
Earlier, CE said it was formally posting its offer document for the company after announcing the bid last week.
The cash bid offered 630p per Northern Electric ordinary share and 103p per preference share.
